paragraphs: Rav Mesharshiya son of Rav Dimi. Mentioned in Gittin 78a.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Gittin 78a follows עח. under the period convention, without independent named-edition verification.
בריה דרב דימי explicitly gives “son of Rav Dimi.” Both Rav titles are written in full; the notice supplies no further biography.
